subject: Weekly exec synthesizer: wins, risks, asks + QBR checklist
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Leadership Distro <leadership@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Feb 2027 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Weekly exec synthesizer: wins, risks, asks + QBR checklist

Team —

This week’s condensed readout for the exec distro. I’ve pulled the most time-sensitive wins/risks/asks for QBR prep. Please review and reply with any changes by EOD Wed so I can fold into the QBR draft. Attaching a living checklist (QBR_checklist_v1.xlsx) and a short asks PDF for sales/partnership items.

Wins
- Demo-to-SQL conversion uplift: Sales reports a 22% improvement on the new runtime benchmarks after the batcher patch.
- Dedicated pilot: Acme Corp pilot passed initial throughput validation at target 95th-pct latency.

Risks
- Model fallbacks: Two key models show occasional regressions under long-context tests (LL-102, LL-137). Research has a mitigation plan but needs runway.
- Partner onboarding friction: Orion Cloud partner integration is delayed by a missing SSO token exchange spec.

Asks (prioritized)
1) Engineering: Can research commit to a mitigation timeline for model regressions (ETA: 2 weeks)? I need a clear rollback/mitigation note for QBR.
2) Sales/Ops: Monica — confirm renewal timeline and any payment/contractary asks for Acme (they requested a shortened procurement window).
3) Partnerships: Karthik — get the SSO spec from Orion Cloud and assign an eng owner for the token exchange.

QBR checklist (high level) — items to confirm before slide deck:
- Customer success metrics for Acme pilot (throughput, latency, ticket volume)
- Any outstanding security evidence requests (SOC2 artifacts)
- Cost deltas pre/post-batcher (per-token and infra)
- Go/no-go decision for new model rollout gating

Quick timeline: please reply with confirmations/edits by 23:59 PT Wed (2027-02-10). If I don’t get objections, I’ll finalize slides Thu morning.

Thanks —
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Head of GTM Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Leadership Distro <leadership@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Feb 2027 11:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Weekly exec synthesizer: wins, risks, asks + QBR checklist

Priya —
Quick note: research confirms they’ve reproduced the LL-102 regression locally and will prioritize a hotfix. Tentative ETA: 10 business days for a patch and 3 business days for a validation pass. I’ll escalate if anything slips.

Also, I’ll add a short paragraph on fallback policies for the QBR (how we route to smaller-quantized variants and SLA impact).

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Serving & Runtime
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Leadership Distro <leadership@redwood.com>, csm@acme.com
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Weekly exec synthesizer: wins, risks, asks + QBR checklist

Thanks, Priya. Quick updates from my side on Acme and the procurement thread:
- Acme renewal: they’ve signaled intent to renew but asked for a 45-day procurement window. Legal is reviewing the standard SOW; I expect a redline package by Fri.
- Billing ask: they asked for a short-term credit if latency bump occurs during rollout. I propose we offer a one-time credit tied to measured 95th-pct latency breaches during the canary period — happy to align on terms.

On data for the QBR: CS will deliver throughput/latency charts and the initial support ticket log by Wed noon. I attached a short Acme summary in the deck (Sales_Motion_asks_2027-02-08.pdf).

Monica Patel
Head of Sales Operations
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Leadership Distro <leadership@redwood.com>, acme-ops@acme.com, devlin@orioncloud.com
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Weekly exec synthesizer: wins, risks, asks + QBR checklist

Appreciate the quick responses — consolidate below to close the loop for the QBR deck: 

Consolidated status (for slides)
- Win: Demo-to-SQL conversion uplift confirmed; include baseline vs current conversion rate and a short note on batcher patch. (Engineering & Sales validated)
- Risk & mitigation: LL-102 regression — Research ETA: patch in ~10 business days; validation following 3 days. Add fallback policy summary and expected customer impact (minimal with current fallbacks).
- Acme renewal: Intent to renew, procurement window requested (45 days). Monica/legal will deliver redline by Fri. Proposed one-time credit for latency breaches during canary; Monica to propose language.
- Partnerships: Orion Cloud — Karthik, please provide SSO spec and assign eng owner; include expected integration delta in the partner spin-up slide.

Remaining asks (action owners)
- Vivek: Short fallback policy paragraph + mitigation ETA for inclusion in QBR (due Thu 09:00 PT).
- Monica: Acme redline status and draft credit language (due Wed 12:00 PT).
- Karthik: Orion SSO spec and assignment (due Wed 17:00 PT).
- Laura: If any leadership-level notes for executive summary, send by Thu 08:00 PT.

I’ll patch slides Thu morning and circulate the draft to this thread. If you need me to pull any specific visuals, ping and I’ll carve time.

Attachments: QBR_checklist_v1.xlsx, Sales_Motion_asks_2027-02-08.pdf

Thanks —
Priya
Head of GTM Operations | Redwood Inference
